title: Fleet waste alarm resets its 24h baseline
description: Read-only viability assessment found scripts/fleet-guards.sh:88-114 requires AGE > 86400 before computing cost-per-close, but overwrites burn-snapshot.json with the current timestamp on every cycle (default 10 minutes). Under normal continuous operation AGE never reaches 24 hours, so the waste alarm does not evaluate. This is separate from the intentional budget policy (the 2000 USD milestone is advisory and the ceiling was removed); do not change that policy as part of fixing the baseline. No fleet state or source changed in the assessment.
acceptance_criteria: Use a retained baseline or rolling history so a deterministic independently specified sequence of 10-minute observations crosses 24 hours and triggers the configured cost-per-close alarm. Cover first run and restart behavior without real provider calls; preserve existing budget/pause policy. Run tests and three independent correctness/security/robustness reviews before closure.
